_comment: Grandfathered `*-card` class BLOCKS that are deliberately NOT rendered on a BDS <Card>. Read by scripts/lint-card-class.mjs (brikdesigns#1260). Each entry carries its reason, because that is the whole point of the list — an unexplained name here is indistinguishable from unpaid debt. The gate ratchets both ways: adding an unbacked card without an entry fails, and leaving an entry for a name that has since been converted or deleted also fails. Only ever remove entries; adding one needs a reason a reviewer would accept, not 'it was easier'.

allowed.about-team-card: A semantic <article> (a person's bio is standalone content). BDS Card renders a <div> or an <a> and exposes no `as` prop, so converting it would trade correct document semantics for shared chrome. Its chrome already matches the standard by hand — surface-primary + --border-width-200 solid --border-secondary + --border-radius-md, i.e. exactly what `<Card variant="outlined">` plus the 'Card border-width standard' rule produce.
allowed.contact-card: A page-level panel, not a Card: 1100px wide, --border-radius-lg, no border and no shadow, filling a full-viewport --surface-brand-primary band. The 'Card chrome by band' rule has no entry for a saturated brand band, and the CLAUDE.md card-treatment rule forbids reaching for variant="elevated" to fake it. Misnamed rather than mis-built — the layer is a Container, not a card.
allowed.cta-card-brand: The shared brand CTA panel (a Section-level band child on /about, /blog, /blog/[slug], /customers, /customers/[slug], /how-we-work, /results, /results/[slug]). Fixed brand-orange fill, no card chrome to inherit. Already the ONE such panel — it absorbed the /blog-only `.cta-card` twin in #1260.
allowed.hiw-card: A semantic <article> process step on /how-we-work, with a two-pane internal layout (content + checklist pane) that the Card content slot does not model. Same <article>-vs-<div> trade as about-team-card.
allowed.plans-card-wrapper: A layout wrapper around a BDS <PricingCard> plus its illustration — the media sits OUTSIDE the pricing card by design (PlanCardGrid.tsx). The card in this composition is the PricingCard; the wrapper is the grid cell.
allowed.services-card-link: A Next.js <Link> wrapping the real BDS <Card> (`services-card`) so the whole cell navigates. Chrome lives on the inner Card; this carries only display/text-decoration/height. Correct as-is.
allowed.value-card: A numbered pillar tile on /value — an icon + number + title in a fixed four-color set, sized and spaced as a nav pillar rather than a content card. No card chrome to inherit; the colored fill IS the affordance.
